items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Because him and Chris used to be together all the time. See, Howard was a drummer. See, and then Chris taught him a whole lot, see.

ctx.x: Yeah. Of course, is that record which you made with Bill Russell there, with Kid Howard, where he plays on more on one of the numbers anyway, the Careless Love, which is supposed to be kind of close to the way Chris played that.

Well, it's a symbol. You see, you take Howard now. Howard is more closer to Chris than anyone of them, you know what I mean? Because him and Chris used to be together all the time. See, Howard was a drummer. See, and then Chris taught him a whole lot, see. And that's where he'd try to pick up Chris Kelly's style, you know. But he did pretty nice. He did pretty nice. He was good. He was a strong man, you know what I mean? Trumpets. He'd go up there and get them higher notes. Howard did. Oh, yeah. He'd get them. He…
Yes, yes. He got some Armstrong stuff. That's what he had. Sure did.
